description:
✔Powerful endurance
HITWAY BK29M has a 48V 15AH extra large battery. The battery is equipped with a key to prevent theft. The battery is removable and can be charged anytime, anywhere. Equipped with energy recovery system, the maximum range of 6-7 hours per charge can be more than 50km. Whether for the daily commute or for an outdoor adventure, this bike is the perfect choice.
✔ High Quality Tires
This electric bike uses 20*4.0 inch tires, which can easily cope with road conditions such as cities, mountains, snow and beaches. It is non-slip, puncture resistant and can also provide extra shock absorption. No fear of road conditions, you can commute freely and experience a more comfortable driving experience.
✔ Excellent Drive System
The HITWAY BK29M electric bike is equipped with a powerful brushless motor, which can reach a maximum speed of 32km/h, offering you strong performance at any time on your ride. The maximum gradient is 25°, so you don't have to fear any obstacles on mountain and forest paths. And thus pushes the limits of driving pleasure.
✔ Multiple Driving Modes
3 driving modes + 7-speed gear. Fast, easy and reliable speed adjustment for a hassle-free ride. Also, it has an intelligent LCD display that shows various information such as speed, distance and battery level. It allows you to activate multiple functions with simple on-screen actions, making your driving smarter and easier.
✔ Safe and Comfortable Driving Support
The hydraulic front fork and the central shock absorber system make you worry-free with every bump. The highly elastic and high-quality memory foam saddle ensures more comfort during your ride. The front and rear disc brakes can effectively decelerate and stop, which increases driving safety. The extra large and bright LED front light ensures maximum safety when driving at night.
